name: clover_tspulse
title: Clover TSPulse CPU worker
description: Pinned TSPulse CPU anomaly detection, imputation, embeddings and similarity. Preserves Clover Zoo v2 windows and outputs.

tests.name: real_inference
tests.sql: DO $$ DECLARE v jsonb; BEGIN v := rvbbit.clover_tspulse('timeseries_embed',jsonb_build_object('values',(SELECT jsonb_agg(sin(i/10.0)) FROM generate_series(1,512) i))::text); IF (v->>'dimension')::int < 1 OR jsonb_array_length(v->'embedding') <> (v->>'dimension')::int OR v IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CPU inference failed: %',v; END IF; END $$;
